description: Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive wastewater reuse in England is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment Agency. This spreadsheet contains estimates of the total volume of wastewater treated and the total reused at treatment plants reported under the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive for England in 2012. This covers all treatment plants serving population equivalents (P.E.) greater than 2000 if discharging to freshwater, or greater than 10000 if discharging to coastal/transitional waters. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Environment Agency. Its tags are EC directive, environment, urban wastewater, water quality, water reuse. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
